column1: # tools/adaptation-census.tsv — projection census read by tools/check-adaptation-boundary.sh
# and tools/check-utility-census.py. One name per line, sorted within each list, so adding a
# file is a one-line change. Columns: list<TAB>name.
#   shared-utility-deferred  utilities/* that stay at the portable root for every adapter
#   utility-deferred         utilities/* with no adapters/{codex,opencode}/utilities projection
#                            (token-budget*.py are listed here for OpenCode; Codex projects them
#   tool-deferred            tools/* with no adapters/{codex,opencode}/tools projection
# *.test.py/*.test.sh utilities defer automatically. The short projected lists stay in the
# script beside the checks that verify each projected link.
